Adding myself to `contributors/`.

- [ ] The file is named `contributors/<my-github-username>.md`
- [ ] The `github:` field matches my GitHub username
- [ ] `knows:` only uses values from the list in the README
- [ ] This pull request changes nothing else

A bot checks this and merges it. If something needs changing it will say exactly
what, right here in this thread. Push the fix to the same branch and it merges
itself. There is no need to close this and open a new one.
